newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat quiet, nearby months ease.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat quiet, nearby months ease.

text.p: LIFFE wheat grain futures ended a quiet day mixed, with the nearby months easier.
"The market moved off a bit on currency this morning," one trader said. News of the EU tender bids helped it firm slightly from lows, he said.
But volume was small and inflated by crosses, he said.
Active May last traded 0.20 stg lower at 98.70 stg per tonne. May volume was 134 lots of a total 249.
Other months ranged between 0.25 stg down and 0.15 stg up.
News of the EU's award of 273,500 tonnes of wheat came too late to be influence LIFFE trading. But it is likely to be seen as mildly friendly, the trader said.
Barley firmed, with active March up 0.50 stg at 90.00 stg. March volume was 15 lots of a total 30.
